member.name: P:KineticaRT.Logic.Channels.Now.Format
member.summary: Gets or sets the format of the channel when viewed as text.
member.value: A string describing the display format of the channel.
member.remarks:
The following formats can be used:
"d" - Short date
"D" - Long date
"f" - Long date, short time
"F" - Long date, long time
"g" - short date, short time
"G" - short date, long time
"t" - short time
"T" - Long time
"u" - Universal time (sortable)
"U" - Universal time
"dddd yyyy/MM/dd hh:mm:ss fff" - Custom
